subject: Error message in MRDS engine "unexpected )" - an explanation and solution

messages.author: 7482eee8d2863d12
messages.subject: Error message in MRDS engine "unexpected )" - an explanation and solution
parts:
Hi Folks,

A user recently reported to me getting an error message in the MRDS engine; we found the source of the problem so I thought I'd document it on the list in case anyone else gets the same issue.

Situation:
Using the MRDS engine to model double-platform data, wanting to fit an intercept-only MR model.  You get the following error message:
Error: unexpected ')' in "ddf.3<-ddf(method='io.fi',mrmodel=~glm(link='logit',formula=~)"
Execution halted

Solution:
Check whether you put
1
in the Model formula box under Model Definition Properties | Detection function | MR model.  If you left it blank you'll get the above error message.  Add 1 to the box and re-run, the error should disappear.

This is documented in the help, but it's rather obscure. In Chapter 10 - Mark Recapture Distance Sampling | Defining MRDS models | More About DS and MR Models it says:
"An intercept term is included in formulae by default.  To remove it you can use “- 1” - for example sex - 1, while to specify an intercept-only formula, you use 1 alone."

Best wishes to all, Len
